records.title: PROGRESS UNDER MISSION COKING COAL
details:
The status of modernization and renovation of old washeries of BCCL and CCL is
tabulated below:
BCCL Madhuban Washery: Renovation estimate under preparation
CCL Kedla Washery: Renovation proposal under approval.
Steel companies have planned phased installation of stamp-charged coke oven batteries, to
enable higher utilization of indigenous coking coal through blending upto 30% by FY2030.
